read.thesis: Nitrogen pricing strong and CF's cost edge intact, but the Yazoo City outage cuts 2026 ammonia output to about 9.5M tons, with Q4 volumes down and capex stepping up to about $1.3B.

utilisation.quote: The Company expects gross ammonia production in 2026 to be approximately 9.5 million tons due to the ongoing outage at the Yazoo City, Mississippi, Complex

capex.peers_comment: Management said new North American ammonia production is expected to reach commercial rates in 2026, increasing traded supply available globally.
capex.quote: management projects capital expenditures for full year 2026 will be approximately $1.3 billion

triggers.label: 2026 ammonia output 9.5Mt on Yazoo outage
triggers.quote: The Company expects gross ammonia production in 2026 to be approximately 9.5 million tons due to the ongoing outage

triggers.label: Q4 ammonia ASP and NA margin strong
triggers.quote: Average selling prices were higher for all segments in the fourth quarter of 2025
triggers.highlight: Average selling prices were higher for all segments

triggers.label: European curtailments ~20% ammonia, 25% urea
triggers.quote: Approximately 20% of ammonia capacity and 25% of urea capacity in Europe was curtailed as of December 2025
triggers.highlight: Approximately 20% of ammonia capacity and 25% of urea capacity

triggers.label: Channel inventory below historical average
triggers.quote: Management believes that nitrogen channel inventory remains lower than historical averages.
triggers.highlight: nitrogen channel inventory remains lower than historical averages

triggers.label: New NA ammonia supply reaches commercial rates 2026
triggers.quote: New North American ammonia production is expected to reach commercial rates in 2026, increasing traded supply available globally.

guidance.quote: The Company expects gross ammonia production in 2026 to be approximately 9.5 million tons
management projects capital expenditures for full year 2026 will be approximately $1.3 billion

guidance.metric: CF capex excluding JV partner funding 2026
guidance.quote: For the full year, management projects capital expenditures for CF Industries, excluding the portion of capital expenditures funded by JERA and Mitsui, to be approximately $950 million.
Management does not expect production to resume at the Yazoo City Complex until the fourth quarter of 2026 at the earliest

red_flags.label: Yazoo City outage removes ~0.6Mt ammonia in 2026
red_flags.quote: due to the ongoing outage at the Yazoo City, Mississippi, Complex as a result of an incident that occurred in late 2025

red_flags.label: Q4 volumes down, customer advances fell
red_flags.quote: Sales volumes were lower in the fourth quarter of 2025 compared to the fourth quarter of 2024 due primarily to lower granular urea and ammonium nitrate (AN) sales.
